props.gloss_en: R' Yochanan: [digestion lasts] as long as he is not hungry
Reish Lakish: as long as he is thirsty on account of his eating
Rav Ami in Reish Lakish's name: the measure of digestion is the time it takes to walk four mil
here [the four mil] -- with a large meal (the pairing is Steinsaltz's)
here [as long as he is thirsty] -- with a small meal (the pairing is Steinsaltz's)

objections.gloss_en: מי אמר ריש לקיש הכי? והאמר רב אמי אמר ריש לקיש: כדי להלך ארבע מילין! -- did Reish Lakish say thirst? Rav Ami reports him saying four mil
